gen-zen-dots-gf-cantarell: Friendly and techy up top, Zen Dots spreads its rounded shapes out generously, while Cantarell keeps its arches tidy and its sans-serif strokes easygoing. Paragraphs flow along without a hitch.
gen-zen-dots-gf-carme: Carme reads with open, outward-leading counters and a line that unspools like spaghetti, soft and modern in sans-serif form. Zen Dots does the showy, spaced-out heading work; Carme just keeps the text moving.
gen-zen-dots-gf-catamaran: Catamaran brings curvy, unclamped letters that feel loose and approachable beneath the heading. And Zen Dots, with generous space around each shape, gives the page a techy, friendly start before the text takes over.
gen-zen-dots-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Zen Dots gives every letter a generous margin of space, which makes the heading feel techy and welcoming at once. And Chiron Hei HK answers with a wide-open c, like a bracelet pulled apart, for a modern finish.
gen-zen-dots-gf-commissioner: Friendly, with a techy streak: Zen Dots leaves lots of room around each letter. Commissioner then carries the text in smooth, unclogged curves, every stroke drawn at one thickness, so the reading glides.
gen-zen-dots-gf-didact-gothic: Didact Gothic reads smoothly, never snagging on a closed-up bowl, every stroke carrying the same visual weight in a modern sans. Zen Dots is best at roomy, techy display lettering; Didact Gothic is best at drawing the eye along a line.
gen-zen-dots-gf-dotgothic16: Zen Dots sets a friendly, techy tone with generous space around every letter, at any weight. But DotGothic16 holds a wire-bent, constant thickness through each bend, which makes it the steadier worker for the text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-doto: Doto leaves wide margins of space around each glyph, with generous mouths on its round letters. Doto handles the text quietly, while Zen Dots does the showy, techy heading work with its own spacious letter shapes.
gen-zen-dots-gf-electrolize: Modern and contemporary, Electrolize brings an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers. Under Zen Dots, whose spacious techy letters feel friendly, it sits as a quieter, tighter sibling in sans-serif form.
gen-zen-dots-gf-elms-sans: Zen Dots stands out for the generous room it leaves around every letter, keeping its techy shapes friendly. Elms Sans follows with a ballpoint's pressure-free line and a see-through gap in each s, so the page feels open all the way down.
